explication_en: Watchy is an Arduino library for an e-paper watch: src/Watchy.cpp orchestrates the display (Display.cpp), the clock (WatchyRTC.cpp), the accelerometer (bma.cpp) and Bluetooth (BLE.cpp). The watch faces in the examples/WatchFaces folder, such as 7_SEG or Tetris, inherit from this class and are listed in extras/WatchFaces/index.json.
